title: Media data processing steps refernce undefined "initial playback position" concept
body:
In the media data processing steps algorithm, steps 10 and 11 of [Once enough of the media data has been fetched...](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#getting-media-metadata) reference the concept of "initial playback position".

That concept no longer exists in HTML. The closest to it is the notion of [current playback position](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/media.html#current-playback-position). It would be useful to clarify the relationship between "initial playback position" and "current playback position". Perhaps simply by replacing the variable with something like "initial value of the current playback position" (with a reference to "current playback position") if that is what it means.

FWIW, HTML 5.1 included a definition of [initial playback position](https://www.w3.org/TR/2017/REC-html51-20171003/semantics-embedded-content.html#initial-playback-position)... although I would say it suffered from the same issue: that term wasn't really used in connection with anything else, so it was not necessarily clear how setting that position impacted the current playback position in any way.

Via https://github.com/w3c/media-source/pull/300#discussion_r718198548
